policy.purpose: lookup of rights-cleared Roblox UI already in hand, so an interface is adapted rather than invented
policy.sourceBytesNote: the index is the library; the bytes live in the gitignored rows.jsonl and are re-fetchable from each asset's pinned revision, exactly as repos.jsonl already treats them
policy.primaryKey: compositionKey — the sorted GUI classes the file constructs. Every asset has one.
policy.secondaryKey: screen — present only where the file names itself. null is an answer, not a gap.
policy.trainingApprovedNote: nothing here is approved for training. Every row carries training_approved:false and semantic_quality_pass:null upstream, and this file changes neither.

totals.usableMeaning: hand-written AND observed to parse. An asset whose parse was never measured is not counted here, because un-disproven is not proven — that is the shape an empty grep takes when it is read as a clean result. This is the number to quote when asked how many UI assets are in hand.
totals.screenSelfDescriptionNote: most Roblox UI source does not name the screen it builds; that is a fact about the corpus, and filing the rest under a guess would make the library confidently wrong
